text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah got injured during training, 
so I rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply sorry.
choice_data_list:
It's okay, let's get some proper rest and 
make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No. It is not about that. It is about 
what I am going to say next.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I know I'm asking for the 
impossible. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Could you... let me train?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I watched the footage of my mother over 
and over. That is precisely why I—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to halt all the efforts we've 
built up until now... Not over something 
like this.
choice_data_list: You should focus on resting for now.

You really should focus on resting for 
now.
...All right. Make sure not to overdo it.

...Understood. Just don't push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to halt all the efforts we've 
built up until now... Not over something 
like this.
choice_data_list: You should focus on resting for now.

You really should focus on resting for 
now.
...All right. Make sure not to overdo it.

...Understood. Just don't push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Still.
choice_data_list:
Pushing yourself too hard is what can ruin 
all your effort.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—...gh... Thank you very much... You 
are... absolutely right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What's important is making a full 
recovery... For now, I'll focus completely 
on that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah obediently dedicated herself 
to resting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It felt like my legs were dragging a 
little. ...I'll call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much for indulging my 
selfishness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah's injury has worsened. It was 
decided that she should take some time off 
to rest immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There is no problem. There's no particular 
pain, either.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much for giving 
your permission.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue at this pace, one step at 
a time, marching forward with courage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah continued light training after 
that, and before long, she was making a 
smooth comeback.
